concerns.text: The spec calls for 'cosine similarity between the subspace bases' to quantify geometric rotation. Cosine similarity is a vector-to-vector metric. Subspaces (bases) are defined only up to rotation and sign; a naive average of cosine similarities between basis vectors is not a rotation-invariant measure of subspace alignment. The spec should specify a proper subspace metric, such as the sum of squared cosines of principal angles or the Frobenius norm of the difference between projection matrices.
